items.name: sugar
items.note: I would put 100 grams next time so it's not so sweet (the original recipe says 150 grams)

steps.text: I make the holes and add the liquid just out of the oven and it turned out PERFECT. If you want to let it cool you can do that too 🤷🏻‍♀️ for me it's better if it's hot but both recipes WORK ✨
I don't have patience BUT if you let it cool all night and then decorate and try it it's MUCH BETTER ❤️
